name: CI Evidence Pack Reference: Deterministic Audit Adoption Path
description: Reference implementation for the v0.8 CI adoption path. The scenario runs the mumei-agent audit CLI in deterministic/no-LLM mode with upstream SARIF, baseline, fail-on, and—when the pinned CLI supports it—migration execution artifacts, derives a migration plan, verifies a reviewed .mm reference contract, and packages the artifacts with explicit evidence boundaries for GitHub Actions.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate a reproducible GitHub Actions evidence-pack shape using the upstream audit CLI SARIF/baseline/fail-on contract without fabricating SARIF or treating CI policy as evidence.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/ci_evidence_pack/src/ledger.py, reference/safe_divide.mm, reference/audit-baseline.json, and reference/workflows/mumei-audit.yml.

Run inputs: the current mumei-agent audit CLI with LLM_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY explicitly empty, --sarif-output, --baseline, --write-baseline, --fail-on high-confidence, plus the local mumei verifier.

Generate evidence and policy artifacts: evidence-pack/audit.json, audit.sarif, audit-baseline.json, migration_plan.json, optional upstream-generated migration_execution.json, verification.json, reference.proof.json, github-actions-mumei-audit.yml, summary.md, manifest.json, and verifier logs.
Boundary: audit output and SARIF are not proof certificates; migration_plan.json is not a completed migration; reference.proof.json proves only the reviewed reference .mm contract.

Artifact roles: audit.json, migration_plan.json, and manifest.json carry canonical artifact_paths plus a closed artifact_roles map; audit.sarif stays inside audit_report, audit-baseline.json is ci_policy, migration_execution.json is migration_execution when emitted, and native_bundle/adapter_observation are empty and must not be relabeled.
SARIF boundary: audit.sarif must be emitted by mumei-agent; this scenario must not fabricate SARIF in mumei-demo.
CI policy boundary: audit-baseline.json suppresses reviewed findings for CI policy only; it is not evidence and must not participate in proof acceptance.

Migration execution boundary: migration_execution.json is emitted only by the upstream audit CLI when --migration-execution-output is available. Unsupported CLIs record not_available_in_current_cli and no file is fabricated; partial artifacts are not completion evidence, generated .mm proof is not host semantic equivalence, and host diagnostics are not adapter observations.
notes: The scenario uses the upstream audit CLI SARIF/baseline/fail-on contract merged in mumei-agent A-1/A-2.
deterministic/no-LLM means the audit child process receives empty LLM_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY values; it does not mean every upstream extraction ambiguity is resolved.
The reference workflow uploads SARIF only after validating that the upstream audit CLI wrote evidence-pack/audit.sarif.
migration_execution.json is capability-dependent because older audit CLIs do not expose --migration-execution-output; the pack schema is mumei-demo.ci-evidence-pack/v2.

intro: Step 1: Run the current audit CLI deterministically against the reference fixture
Step 2: Pack audit, migration-plan, reference-certificate, workflow, and boundary evidence for CI review
narrative.before: A repository owner can read audit JSON manually, but there is no compact reference showing which files belong in a CI evidence pack or where the trust boundary lies.
narrative.after: CI uploads one evidence pack containing the current audit contract, migration plan, reference .mm proof certificate, copyable workflow, and explicit non-claims.

pass.headline: CI evidence pack built with deterministic audit and explicit boundaries
follow_up: audit.sarif and audit-baseline.json are emitted by the upstream audit CLI, not fabricated by the demo
audit-baseline.json is CI policy only; migration hints remain human-review input rather than verified migration evidence

steps.name: Build deterministic CI audit evidence pack
expected_patterns: deterministic audit mode: no LLM credentials
artifact_contract: evidence-pack/audit.json preserves the current fixed audit keys and records the upstream fail-on audit exit code; exit 1 fails the reference gate after the pack is written, while exit 2 is an operational failure.
evidence-pack/audit.sarif is validated as SARIF 2.1.0 emitted by mumei-agent audit; the demo must not fabricate SARIF.
evidence-pack/audit-baseline.json is validated as mumei.audit-baseline/v1 and is CI suppression policy, not evidence or proof acceptance.
evidence-pack/migration_plan.json is derived only from migration_hints and marks every candidate human_review_required.
evidence-pack/reference.proof.json is produced by mumei verify and rechecked by mumei verify-cert --strict for reference/safe_divide.mm.

evidence-pack/manifest.json binds artifact SHA-256 values, keeps native_bundle and adapter_observation empty in artifact_roles, assigns audit-baseline.json to ci_policy, and states that no Python/.mm semantic equivalence is established.
evidence-pack/github-actions-mumei-audit.yml is copied byte-for-byte from the reviewed reference workflow template.

evidence-pack/migration_execution.json is optional only when the pinned audit CLI lacks --migration-execution-output. When the capability exists it must be emitted by the upstream CLI, validate as mumei.migration-execution/v1 with matching execution-state summary counts, and remain outside proof_certificate/adapter_observation/native_bundle roles.

evidence-pack/manifest.json uses schema mumei-demo.ci-evidence-pack/v2 and records migration_execution as emitted_by_audit_cli or not_available_in_current_cli; no migration execution artifact is fabricated by mumei-demo.
steps.verifier_gate: The builder exits 0 for the compliant fixture, audit JSON contains every fixed key, migration_hints yields at least one high-priority review candidate for the division fixture, audit/migration/manifest artifact boundary metadata agrees, the reference proof certificate has all_verified=true, and manifest.json records SARIF/baseline as emitted_by_audit_cli with baseline assigned to ci_policy. Migration execution is optional only for an incapable CLI; when present it is schema-valid upstream evidence with execution_state counts consistent and explicit non-equivalence boundaries.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: v0.8 D-2: integrate the deterministic GitHub Actions evidence pack with the upstream audit SARIF, baseline, and fail-on contract while preserving the demo no-fabrication and evidence-boundary rules.
success_criteria: The current audit CLI runs with no LLM credentials and its fixed JSON keys are preserved.
The pack contains audit JSON, upstream-emitted SARIF, upstream-refreshed baseline, migration plan, proof-certificate path, workflow template, summary, and manifest artifacts.
SARIF is never fabricated by mumei-demo, and baseline is labeled ci_policy rather than evidence.
Evidence boundaries separate audit findings, CI policy, migration scaffolding, reference contract proof, and implementation equivalence.
expected_user_observable_behavior: A reviewer can download one CI artifact and understand what each file does and does not prove.
A repository owner can copy the reference workflow shape, bootstrap a reviewed baseline, and adjust AUDIT_TARGET for its own source tree.
CI fails through the upstream fail-on policy only when non-suppressed findings satisfy the selected policy; baseline suppression never rewrites the fixed audit keys.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Upstream audit output can improve or change verdicts and fingerprints; the scenario gates the fixed key contract, SARIF/baseline schemas, deterministic invocation, and boundary metadata rather than a specific finding count.

success_criteria: evidence-pack/audit.json includes all current fixed audit keys
evidence-pack/audit.sarif is valid SARIF 2.1.0 emitted by the upstream audit CLI
evidence-pack/audit-baseline.json is valid mumei.audit-baseline/v1 and labeled ci_policy rather than evidence
evidence-pack/migration_plan.json contains the divide migration review candidate
audit.json, migration_plan.json, and manifest.json agree on canonical artifact_paths and closed artifact_roles
evidence-pack/github-actions-mumei-audit.yml uses the upstream SARIF/baseline/fail-on contract and uploads SARIF only when the file exists
manifest.json records migration_execution as emitted_by_audit_cli or not_available_in_current_cli without fabricating the upstream artifact
result_message: Result: deterministic CI evidence pack built; upstream SARIF/baseline/fail-on artifacts are present and evidence boundaries are explicit.
